I replied in a thread on your message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api, Hollis. The store is **Pine Crossing**.

Pree raised it in #central-team on Jun 9, during the Marrow Agrisupply rollout escalation. The morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written down on a sticky note. You said then that you'd check the shift template and have support reproduce the problem with the store login.

I couldn't find a site code or address for Pine Crossing in anything you have access to. If the QBR deck needs more than the store name, Pree or store ops should have it.
